<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a11b1ec1c265aea426ad35760cee86ad63d29bb -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next minor cut).

**What looks good**
- Mates refused by name at creation (bodies, picks, solve, non-finite nudge, "nothing would move"); interpenetration warns with part, fixture and point.
- Every locate is one undo step, going through `MoveModel` / `MoveFixture` / `AlignPartToSetup`; layering is respected (pick reader in app, UI only drives commands).
- Provenance lines on all new modules; no new dependency, `build.rs`, script or `.github` change; no snapshot PNG, golden or `CHANGELOG.md` edits.
- Decision file in `docs/decisions/561-locate-part-fixture.md`; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #561`; conventional commit subjects.
- No `unwrap/expect/panic` in non-test added code (only inside test modules).

**Local results** (PR head trial-merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `fixture_locate` | 11 passed |
| app `fixture_locate_stock` | 3 passed |
| app `fixtures` / `fixture_ux` / `fixture_mesh` / `fixture_mesh_posed` | 14 / 9 / 3 / 2 passed |
| app `setup_align` / `plane_align` | 9 / 9 passed |
| app `commands_undo` / `project_roundtrip` | 32 / 69 passed |
| app `mcp` / `mcp_setup` / `mcp_pick` | 13 / 4 / 2 passed |
| ui `--lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 381 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy app + ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The one ui failure is environmental on this Mac, not the PR:
```
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds ... FAILED
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `commands/move_model.rs` grew from 149 to 247 lines and `fixture_locate_solve.rs` is 281; all new files are under ~400.
- The unaligned multi-setup case (part moves in the other setups too, their ops go stale) is the maintainer's call per the PR body; worth a second look at the cut.
- The viewport pick flow was driven headless by the author but not hands-on in the GUI, and I did not launch the GUI.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
